claims.statement: Jack Madden was arrested in Tom Allen's saloon on suspicion of having taken part in a robbery and was taken to the Third Precinct Station.
claims.excerpt: gobbled in Tom Allen’s saloon, last night

claims.statement: Jack Madden was searched at the Third Precinct Station and released at once, as nothing showed he was involved in the crime.
claims.excerpt: he was released at once, there being nothing tendixg to show

notes: The arrest is about Madden but happened in Allen's saloon, so it is recorded. Madden is not Allen.
